Summarise animals, detected or not

Source: R/summarise_detections.R
summarise_animals.Rd

One row per animal in the animals table, plus any animal that has detections and no record there. Animals never detected keep a row with zero detections, so the denominator of a detection rate is all tagged animals.

Usage

summarise_animals(x)

Arguments

x

A detset().

Value

A data frame: animal_id, species (one per animal), transmitters, release_datetime (earliest), detections, days

(UTC dates with a detection), stations, first, last and days_at_liberty (from release, or the first detection, to the last detection; NA when never detected). When no detection has an animal_id, every animal has 0 detections and a message says so.

See also

summarise_detections()

Examples

study <- detqc_example
dets <- detset(study$detections, study$deployments, study$animals)
head(summarise_animals(dets))
#>   animal_id species transmitters    release_datetime detections days
#> 1     ST-01 walleye            1 2024-06-02 15:30:00        846    9
#> 2     ST-02 walleye            1 2024-06-02 15:30:00       1273    9

#> 4     ST-04 walleye            1 2024-06-02 15:30:00        715    9
#>   stations               first                last days_at_liberty
